assets.alt: what’s an extern, actually? the student hospital job nobody explains properly. 60 seconds, with receipts 🧾. swipe. Ontario Extern Tracker.
it’s a real, paid hospital job. you work in an Ontario hospital while you’re still a student. paid, hands-on experience with a real unit team. source: Ontario Health, Jun 2026. checked Nov 13, 2026.

your role on the unit. Your role today. unregulated care provider. Supervised by. regulated health professionals. not a nurse yet, still part of the team. source: Ontario Health, Jun 2026. checked Nov 13, 2026.
4.5M+. hours of coverage from externs every year. thousands of students take part, per Ontario Health. source: Ontario Health, Jun 2026. checked Nov 13, 2026.
two matching rounds a year. Round one. October. Round two. February. put both in your calendar. source: Ontario Health, Jun 2026. checked Nov 13, 2026.
🙌. not just nursing students. more allied health students are joining. think physio, OT and respiratory therapy. source: Ontario Health, Jun 2026. checked Nov 13, 2026.

and it can lead to a job. Ontario Health says hospitals are hiring externs into permanent roles. no promises for anyone, but it’s a real foot in the door. source: Ontario Health, Jun 2026. checked Nov 13, 2026.
